versions.content: Use last received Low Frequency Container on VDP re- quest only The contents of a CAM message is entirely under the responsibility of VDP. Hence, V2X_Fac shall only include the last received Low Frequency Container if VDP requests it. Keeping the consistency between Low Frequency and High Fre- quency container is under the responsibility of VDP.
